Subject: FintechCorp — Security & IR/BCP follow-up

Hi Asha / Daniel —

Thanks for taking time today to walk through FintechCorp's integration plans and security questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: You mentioned an internal SOC 2 program; could you confirm current status (Type I/II, coverage date) and whether you have a SOC 2 report we can share with our compliance team?
- Data regs: You flagged GDPR applicability — understood. Please confirm whether HIPAA applies for this integration.
- Vendor questionnaire: I'm attaching the vendor security questionnaire (FintechCorp_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.docx) — can you confirm the preferred secure channel to return this? Alternatively, you can send completed docs to vendor-security@fintechcorp.com.
- Incident response & breach notification: FintechCorp requested IR/breach timelines. Can you confirm your required notification window (e.g., 72 hours), required evidence (timeline template, contact lists, forensic logs), and preferred point of contact for IR coordination?
- BCP/DR evidence: Common asks are runbooks, RTO/RPO targets, failover runbooks, and proof of DR test results. Let us know which specific artifacts you need and any formats (redacted ok).

Attachments: FintechCorp_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.docx (docx)

Proposed next steps: 
1) If you can confirm SOC 2 status and notification timeline, we will prepare an IR/BCP evidence package (we can redact PoCs and sensitive logs).
2) If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute follow-up with our security lead (Marissa) and engineering (Ben) to walk through evidence and sign any needed NDAs / DPA items.

Thanks — looking forward to your guidance on timelines.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Asha Mehta <asha.mehta@fintechcorp.com>

Subject: Re: FintechCorp — Security & IR/BCP follow-up

Thanks Jordan — great call. Quick responses below (and copied our incident response coordinator at vendor-security@fintechcorp.com).

- SOC 2: We are currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II; fieldwork started Nov 2026 and the expected completion & report availability is Q2 2027 (estimate May 2027). We can share the Type I report and bridge letter now if that helps.
- GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR applies; HIPAA does not apply for this integration.
- Notification window: Per our policy we require initial breach notification within 72 hours of discovery for incidents impacting personal data. Final reports/evidence request timelines can vary; we typically ask vendors to provide an initial incident timeline and evidence package within 7 business days for triage.
- Evidence requested: Our security team will typically ask for: incident response runbook, point-of-contact list (IR/Legal), timeline template, proof of DR tests (last 12 months), and sample (redacted) forensic logs if available.

Preferred delivery: Please upload the completed vendor questionnaire and evidence package to our secure SFTP or send to vendor-security@fintechcorp.com (we prefer SFTP for large bundles). If you send via email, please password-protect zips and share the password over a separate channel.

We can take a brief technical call next week — Daniel and I are available Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Best regards,
Asha Mehta
Head of Vendor Security | FintechCorp

vendor-security@fintechcorp.com
